eligibility_and_terms.automatic_enrollment_trigger: first eligible Binance Square content publication
eligibility_and_terms.payout: USDC to the Binance Funding Account by the Thursday after the Monday through Sunday calculation week
eligibility_and_terms.reader_attribution: reader clicks a cashtag or chart widget in eligible content and then makes an eligible fee-bearing trade shortly afterward
eligibility_and_terms.referral_precedence: a reader who registered through the creator referral link generally produces standard referral rewards rather than Write to Earn commission

limitations: No KYC regional eligibility eligible-post attribution reader-fee row weekly commission row or owned USDC payout was accessed.
The exact meaning of shortly afterward and the complete eligible trade product universe are not specified by the current public Academy article.
Audience acquisition useful-content production moderation legal compliance tax support and operating costs are unproved, so the gross base commission is not net profit.
The 30 and 50 percent totals require a variable weekly top-100 rank and are deliberately excluded from the accepted floor.
A week below 0.1 USDC pays nothing and resets instead of carrying the balance forward.
Reader demand and fee-bearing trade activity can be zero; the accepted edge is a nonnegative gross overlay per independently existing eligible fee, not guaranteed recurring income.

encouraging unnecessary unsuitable leveraged or loss-making trades merely to increase creator commission
misleading deceptive plagiarized spammy or undisclosed promotional content

calling gross USDC commission after-cost profit before owned payout and all audience content compliance tax and operating costs reconcile
